Name: Disk Health & SMART Status
Description: Comprehensive disk health analysis including SMART status, temperature, errors, performance metrics, and reliability predictions. Checks all physical disks or a selected disk.

Params.name: HealthInfo
Params.default:
Comprehensive health analysis for physical disks:
 - SMART Status & Attributes
 - Temperature Monitoring
 - Error Counts (Read/Write/Timeouts)
 - Performance Metrics (IOPS, Throughput)
 - Power-On Hours & Health Score
 - Predicted Failure Analysis
 - Wear Level (for SSDs)
 - Bad Sectors Detection.

Params.name: DiskNumber
Params.label: Select Disk (leave empty for ALL disks)
Params.description: Select specific disk or leave empty to check all physical disks

Params.name: IncludeSMART
Params.label: Include SMART Attributes
Params.description: Show detailed SMART attributes (temperature, errors, power-on hours)

Params.name: CheckBadSectors
Params.label: Scan for Bad Sectors (slow)
Params.description: Perform surface scan to detect bad sectors - may take several minutes
